description: Schedule a finished clip to publish to the user's connected social accounts (tiktok, youtube, instagram, x, linkedin). Use when the user says "post it" or "schedule this for tomorrow". The user must have connected each platform in the ClipSpeed app first. Pass the clip_id (from get_clip_status) and a platforms array.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 time to publish. Omit to publish as soon as possible.

title.description: Post title (used by platforms that have one, e.g. YouTube).

name: schedule_post
